verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an IAM server, since one could ship a conversational admin assistant. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Keycloak offers one. Administration is documented only through the admin console, the kcadm.sh Admin CLI and the Admin REST API, which are structured interfaces, not natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
